listing.description:
ChefSpecials is an AI-powered kitchen companion designed to make everyday cooking easier, more organised and more personal.

It brings recipes, pantry and kitchen inventory, favourites, shopping, ingredient scanning and an interactive AI chef into one connected experience. Instead of simply searching a recipe database, ChefSpecials can work with what you already have, understand what you want to cook, and help turn ingredients into practical meal ideas.

The product is built around the idea that cooking software should adapt to the person using it. ChefSpecials combines structured kitchen data with conversational AI, allowing users to discover recipes, manage ingredients, get contextual cooking help and move naturally from deciding what to eat through to preparing the meal.

ChefSpecials is also a reference implementation of the cApp SDK, combining a full consumer product with portable web, desktop and mobile delivery, integrated cApp sidecars, guided onboarding and support for privacy-friendly local AI.
listing.summary: ChefSpecials cooking product packaged and managed as a cApp project.
